issue.name: The Missouri Issue
issue.tagline: The long read. The bigger picture.

cover.headline: The Looming Brilliance of Buster Faulkner: “If It Works Once, We Retire It”
cover.dek: I’ll be honest. This guy could turn out to be brilliant. Maybe even Steve Spurrier brilliant. But I’d never put him above the Head Ball Coach, or even in the same paragraph. Faulkner has to earn that.

image.alt: The Looming Brilliance of Buster Faulkner: “If It Works Once, We Retire It”
image.credit: Photo by Chris Spears, GatorBait Media · Faulkner: UAA

cover.note: Dek is the published excerpt of the story, Buddy's own words.

columns.label: Columns
columns.note: Franz Beard, Buddy Martin and Eddie Gilley on the week that was.

items.headline: When it came to finding a quarterback Sumrall trusted Buster and it paid off
items.excerpt: Jon Sumrall left the quarterback call to Buster Faulkner, and it paid off.

image.alt: When it came to finding a quarterback Sumrall trusted Buster and it paid off

items.headline: Put Down the Poll, Gators. Missouri Is Waiting.
items.excerpt: Jon Sumrall wants Gator Nation to put down the poll: Florida has lost three of its last four trips to Columbia, and the coach with the raspy voice is making his team pay the toll on “Bloody Tuesday.”

items.headline: Who are these guys? Trautwein's troops in the trenches are difference makers
items.excerpt: “Who are these guys?” We could be asking the same question of the Florida offensive line.

image.alt: The guys up front helped Jadan Baugh score another touchdown against Ole Miss
image.credit: Photo by Chris Spears, GatorBait Media

items.headline: How The Gators Sealed And Secured A 52-28 Rout Of No. 4 Ole Miss With a Pick, Again
items.excerpt: Eddie Gilley breaks down the five plays that decided Florida's 52-28 rout of No. 4 Ole Miss, from a blown fourth-down gamble to DJ Coleman's game-sealing interception.
